setting.heading: Settings
setting.mobile-notice: Some advanced features (panels, notes, OBS) are only available on desktop.
setting.tablet-notice: Panel features enabled. Notes and OBS are only available on desktop.
setting.show-floating-stats-desc: Display a floating widget on screen showing real-time word count progress.
setting.enable-mobile-focus-timer-desc: Show a timer in the mobile floating widget and automatically filter out screen-off and background time. Data syncs with desktop.
setting.enable-homepage-desc: When enabled, a creative homepage is automatically generated in the workspace. Disabling deletes the homepage file (work info is preserved).
setting.open-homepage-on-startup-desc: Automatically open the creative homepage each time Obsidian starts.
setting.custom-homepage-filename-desc: Change the default homepage filename in the file tree (no .md suffix needed). Leave empty to restore the default "Creative Homepage". Renames the existing homepage automatically.
setting.custom-welcome-desc: Welcome message displayed at the top of the creative homepage. Leave empty for dynamic time-based greeting.
setting.homepage-pin-position-desc: Pin the creative homepage in the file explorer to prevent manual reordering when new works are added.
setting.pin-none: Unpinned (sorted by rules or manual drag)
setting.workspace-folders-desc: Leave empty for global scope. Separate multiple with commas.
setting.select-folder-tooltip: Select an existing folder from vault
setting.strict-chapter-mode-desc: All word-count-related features (goals, statistics, reminders, etc.) only take effect in documents that match chapter naming rules.
setting.exception-directories-desc: Files in these directories are exempt from strict chapter mode and always counted. Separate multiple directories with commas.
setting.smart-chapter-sort-desc: Recognize chapter numbers in the file tree and force numerical sorting.
setting.chapter-template-desc: When enabled, creating a new chapter (including via commands and workbench) will automatically use configured template content. A prompt will appear if multiple templates exist.
setting.chapter-template-list-desc: Configure Markdown template files for creating new chapters. When multiple templates exist, a selection dialog will pop up.
setting.chapter-template-list-empty: No template files added yet. Click the button on the right to select a Markdown file from vault.
setting.chapter-template-path-desc: No template file selected. Click the button on the right to choose a Markdown file from vault.
setting.select-file-placeholder: Search or select Markdown template file...
template.choice-modal-desc: Multiple chapter templates are configured. Please select a template to create the new chapter:
template.no-template-desc: Create a blank Markdown document without any template content.
setting.enable-eyecare-desc: Replace the editor and reader background with an eye-care color. Other UI remains unchanged.
setting.eyecare-bg-color-desc: Low-saturation greens or warm tones are recommended to reduce eye strain.
setting.word-count-mode-desc:
Choose the underlying word counting algorithm (switching triggers a full re-calculation).
Web Novel Mode: All non-whitespace characters count as 1 word (including punctuation).
Standard Mode: English words are merged, full-width punctuation counts as 1 word.
Native Mode: All punctuation is completely ignored.
setting.mode-standard: Standard Mode (English as Words, Full-Width Punctuation Counts)
setting.show-status-bar-progress-desc: Display current chapter progress in the Obsidian bottom status bar.
setting.show-explorer-counts: Show Word Counts in File Explorer
setting.show-explorer-counts-desc: Display aggregated word counts in the sidebar file tree.
setting.word-count-gutter-desc: When enabled, cumulative word count markers are displayed in the left gutter area at the configured interval.
setting.word-count-interval-desc: Set how many words between each gutter marker.
setting.default-chapter-goal-desc: Default target word count for each chapter.
setting.daily-goal-desc: Target for total new words written today.
setting.sticky-note-autosave-desc: When enabled, note content is saved to memory and file in real time. When disabled, you are prompted to save manually only when closing a note.
setting.task-filename-desc: Task data is saved to this file in the current folder (no .md suffix needed).
setting.immersive-layout-builder-desc: Freely assign auxiliary panels around the main editor via dropdown menus. If no components are assigned to a side, the editor automatically extends to that edge.
setting.immersive-hide-properties-desc: Automatically hide the Markdown file properties panel at the top in immersive mode.
setting.immersive-note-size-desc: Square side length for notes in immersive mode.
setting.immersive-note-font-size-desc: Font size inside the note text area in immersive mode.
setting.immersive-typewriter-enable-desc: Keep current line centered in immersive mode and fade non-focused lines.
setting.immersive-typewriter-offset-desc: Fine-tune cursor vertical position offset (-30% to +30%).
setting.foreshadowing-filename-desc: Marked foreshadowing is saved to this file in the current folder (no .md suffix needed).
setting.common-tags-desc: Separate with spaces. Click to quickly add when annotating foreshadowing.
setting.lore-folder-name-desc: All documents in this folder will be scanned and parsed. The plugin automatically extracts headings (## Proper Name) and inline aliases (**Alias**: xxx) from documents. When you type these names in novel text, they get underlined and support precise hover cards.
setting.lore-folder-name-desc-prefix: Specify the folder name where lore entries are stored for each work.
setting.enable-mobile-lore-popover: Enable Lore Hover Popover on Mobile
setting.enable-mobile-lore-popover-desc: When disabled, lore names will still be scanned and styled with dashed underlines on mobile, but tapping them will not trigger popovers to prevent mis-clicks while scrolling.
setting.timeline-filename-desc: Timeline data is saved to this file in the current folder (no .md suffix needed).
setting.timeline-default-types-desc: Separate with spaces. Selectable from a dropdown when adding timeline events.
setting.idle-threshold-desc: If no keyboard input occurs within this time, even while the app is focused, the time is counted as "slacking off".
setting.enable-obs-overlay-desc: Start a local HTTP server. OBS loads the real-time stats panel via a Browser Source with zero disk I/O.
setting.overlay-port-desc: Port number for the OBS browser source. Changing requires an overlay restart.
setting.overlay-opacity-desc: Adjust the OBS overlay card background opacity (0 = fully transparent).
setting.custom-css-desc: Override styles via CSS class names
setting.copy-obs-url-desc: Click to copy the URL. Add a "Browser Source" in OBS and paste this URL.
setting.lore-popover-collapse-desc: When enabled, subheadings (### and below) in lore hover cards will be collapsed by default. Click to expand.
setting.lore-graph-auto-link-mentions-de: When enabled, the lore graph will automatically connect nodes that "mention" each other (including aliases) in the document text. When disabled, it will only connect explicitly defined relationships (e.g., using ### Relations).
setting.lore-graph-enable-global-desc: When enabled, the graph will read all files in the entire lore folder to generate a global relationship graph. Performance may be affected when there are many lore files.
setting.debug-mode-desc: Enable debug mode to output high-precision performance timings and detailed execution logs in the DevTools console.
